label: Bible Study
prompt: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be _____, and thy house.
verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
note: The Philippian jailer asked what to do — the answer fit in one sentence.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let us therefore come _____ unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verse: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
note: Come boldly — not sheepishly — to the throne. It's a throne of grace, not of grading.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will _____ from you.
verse: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
note: The promise is startlingly practical: resist, and the devil doesn't negotiate — he flees.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall _____; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
verse: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
note: Micah's comeback verse: falling isn't final, and even his darkness has a light in it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let us hold fast the _____ of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verse: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
note: The KJV holds fast the 'profession' of our faith — the thing you said out loud. Don't waver.
